name: bench-boot

scripts.build: tish build src/main.tish --target gba -o "$npm_package_name.gba" && for v in floor v_font v_sheets v_scenes v_native v_named68 v_ui v_dialog v_engine v_packages; do tish build "src/$v.tish" --target gba -o "$v.gba" || exit 1; done
scripts.agb-floor: cd agb-floor && cargo build --release && agb-gbafix target/thumbv4t-none-eabi/release/agb_floor -o agb-floor.gba

description: A benchmark testing the performance of the boot subsystem.
